api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Projects: List Projects

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ProjectNumber, ProjectName, ProjectStatus, BusinessUnit, ProjectManagerId, StartDate. Example: q=ProjectStatus='ACTIVE'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: tasks, team, deliverables, budgets, costs
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of projects. Supports filtering by status, business unit, and project manager.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Projects: Get a Project

api_arguments.ProjectId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the project.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: tasks, team, deliverables, budgets, classifications, customers
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific project including schedule, team, and financial summary.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Projects: Create a Project

api_arguments.ProjectNumber: string: Unique project number. Auto-generated if not provided.
api_arguments.ProjectTemplateId: integer: Template identifier to inherit structure and settings from.
api_arguments.BusinessUnitId: [REQUIRED] integer: Business unit that owns this project.
api_arguments.LegalEntityId: integer: Legal entity for financial reporting.
api_arguments.ProjectManagerId: [REQUIRED] integer: PersonId of the project manager.
api_arguments.ProjectStatus: string: Status of the project. Valid values: ACTIVE, PENDING, CLOSED. Default: PENDING.
api_arguments.StartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Project start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.FinishDate: string: Project planned finish date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.ProjectCurrency: string: Currency code for project financials. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.BillingMethod: string: Billing method for customer-facing projects. Valid values: Fixed Price, Time and Materials, Cost Plus.
api_arguments.CustomerId: integer: Customer account identifier for billable projects.

functionality: Creates a new project in Oracle Project Management Cloud.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Tasks: List Project Tasks

api_arguments.ProjectId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the project.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports TaskName, TaskNumber, Status, MilestoneFlag, ParentTaskId. Example: q=MilestoneFlag='Y'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: resources, costs, dependencies
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 50.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves tasks belonging to a specific project, including milestones and subtasks.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Tasks: Create a Task

api_arguments.ProjectId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the project.
api_arguments.TaskNumber: string: Unique task number within the project. Auto-generated if not provided.
api_arguments.ParentTaskId: integer: Identifier of the parent task for hierarchical WBS structures.
api_arguments.StartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Planned start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.FinishDate: [REQUIRED] string: Planned finish date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.MilestoneFlag: string: Whether this task is a milestone. Valid values: Y, N. Default: N.
api_arguments.BillableFlag: string: Whether work on this task is billable to the customer. Valid values: Y, N.
api_arguments.ChargeableFlag: string: Whether costs are charged to this task. Valid values: Y, N.
api_arguments.TaskManagerId: integer: PersonId of the task manager.
api_arguments.Description: string: Description or scope of the task.

functionality: Creates a new task in a project's work breakdown structure (WBS).

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Project Resources: List Project Team Members

api_arguments.ProjectId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the project.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PersonId, JobId, StartDate, FinishDate, ResourceType. Example: q=ResourceType='Named'
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves team members assigned to a project, including their roles, planned hours, and assignment dates.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Project Budgets: Get Project Budget

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ProjectId, BudgetTypeCode, VersionStatus. Example: q=ProjectId=300000001234567 and VersionStatus='APPROVED'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, resources
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves cost or revenue budget versions for a project. Filter by budget type (cost or revenue) and status.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Expenditures: Create an Expenditure Item

api_arguments.ExpenditureTypeId: [REQUIRED] integer: Expenditure type identifier (e.g., Labor, Materials, Travel).
api_arguments.ExpenditureItemDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date of the expenditure. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Quantity: [REQUIRED] number: Quantity of the expenditure (e.g., hours, units).
api_arguments.RawCost: number: Raw cost amount in project currency.
api_arguments.PersonId: integer: PersonId of the employee incurring the cost.
api_arguments.OverrideToOrganizationId: integer: Organization to override the default expenditure organization.
api_arguments.Comments: string: Description or notes about the expenditure.

functionality: Creates an expenditure item to record costs against a project task. Used for labor, expense, and miscellaneous cost entry.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Project Contracts: List Project Contracts

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ContractNumber, Status, CustomerId, ProjectId, ContractType. Example: q=Status='ACTIVE' and CustomerId=300000001234567
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, billingControls, fundingSources
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves project contracts used in Oracle Project Billing for customer invoicing and revenue recognition.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Project Invoices: List Project Invoices

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ProjectId, ContractId, Status, InvoiceDate, CustomerId. Example: q=ProjectId=300000001234567 and Status='RELEASED'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, credits
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves customer invoices generated from Oracle Project Billing for billable project work.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Project Issues: List Project Issues

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ProjectId, Status, Priority, AssignedTo, DueDate. Example: q=ProjectId=300000001234567 and Priority='High'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves issues and risks tracked against a project.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Project Management Cloud - Project Deliverables: List Deliverables

api_arguments.ProjectId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the project.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports DeliverableName, Status, DueDate, OwnerId. Example: q=Status='In Progress'
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves deliverables tracked against a project, including their due dates and owners.
